items.summary: Add generated PWA app icon image assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` matching the filenames already referenced by the web manifest and favicon link: `app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `app-icon.dim_512x512.png`.

Add generated Android TWA icon and splash image assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` using the filenames documented in `frontend/android/README.md`: `android-icon-foreground.dim_432x432.png`, `android-icon-background.dim_432x432.png`, and `android-splash.dim_2732x2732.png`.

Update the Android TWA wrapper drawable resources to use the generated icon/splash assets, following `frontend/android/README.md`: copy/replace `app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.png`, `app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_background.png`, and `app/src/main/res/drawable/splash_image.png` with the corresponding generated PNGs from `frontend/public/assets/generated/` so the launcher icon (`@mipmap/ic_launcher`) and splash screen (`@drawable/splash_image`) render correctly.
